entries.6a2eac99f7a4224a: Under the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2026' (formulated in October 2023), the company declares itself a company that solves social issues, and will pursue scale expansion through growth of its DX business and quality reform of its core businesses, as well as a transformation of its business portfolio through the development and expansion of next-generation businesses. In Think Tank and Consulting Services, the company designates electric power and energy, healthcare and nursing care, and business analytics and AI as focus areas, while in IT Services it aims to establish its position as a financial business partner centered on major megabanks. For the fiscal year ending September 2026, the company will partly revise the plan's strategies and targets and advance studies toward formulating the next medium-term management plan.
